answers.what: Deeper is a free set of instructions you add to an AI assistant such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.
answers.does: It rewrites your request into a more detailed, expert-style prompt, shows you the rewrite, and waits for your approval before the AI carries it out.
answers.who: It is for people who want fuller, more thoughtful answers from an AI assistant; the video also says it can be added to coding tools.
answers.next: Go to deeper.tools/start, copy the instructions into an AI chat, then type “/deeper” before your request. The video does not show the exact copying steps or what the instructions contain.
